items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I have 'I Dream of Jeannie,' and I've had 'Drink To Me Only With Thine Eyes' on tape...

ctx.x: I have 'I Dream of Jeannie,' and I've had 'Drink To Me Only With Thine Eyes' on tape, of course. But I haven't even heard 'I'm Happy About The Whole Thing' and 'Corn Pickin' in years.
That's unfortunate, and they're not in the Jazz Institute collection either. Nor the next four that you made. This session claims you back in New York by now. It's the 22nd of August 1939.
